LSR-1.exact_context:
ARTICLE 28


                                     Entitlement to benefits


       (1)     Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Agreement, a benefit under this
Agreement shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or a capital gain if it is
reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining
that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted
directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these
circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions
of this Agreement.

# Gibraltar property conveyance and mortgage stamp duty v0.6

This Guide does not compute a separate penalty or interest amount for the stated job. Keep the domestic return/payment and dispute requirements in the linked taxpayer Guides separate from the allocation, formation or relief test. The unresolved procedural limits remain listed in Sources. This is a scope boundary, not a finding that no penalty applies.

See [Stamping, responsibility and late instruments](#stamping-responsibility-and-late-instruments) in Deadlines and filing for this Guide's section 16 penalty and interest method, and “Base-penalty examples only” in Two worked examples that recompute for its controls. The limitations on later interest notices, day counting and actual settlement remain explicit in that method and Sources.

LSR-2.exact_source_excerpt:
16.(1) Save where other provision is made in this Act, any unstamped or insufficiently
stamped instrument may be stamped after the execution thereof, on payment of the unpaid
duty and a penalty of an amount equal to 10% of the duty payable or £100, whichever shall be
the greater, and also by way of further penalty, where the unpaid duty exceeds £1,000, of
interest on such duty, at the rate of 5 per cent per annum or such other rate which may be
prescribed by the Minister by notice in the Gazette, from the day upon which the instruments
was first executed up to the time when the amount of interest is equal to the unpaid duty.
